security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Markdown maps of your codebase for coding agents
bundle.longDescription: Cartograph reads a project folder and writes one markdown map of it: directory tree, dependency tree, languages and symbols, so a coding agent can read the map instead of crawling the repo. It never changes the folder you scan.
